jad_test.text:
Testing. This is... it's Jad. If this works it'll play it back to me.
[pause]
Right. It works. That's the box done, Inez.

inez_test.text:
Testing two-four-seven, from the frame. Fourteenth of August. Nobody's there, obviously.
When I was nine this was the deep end. Mr. Pardoe used to count to ten with his hand on your head, and you'd come up when he got to ten, and the lights were on under the water, blue, and you thought you'd been down there an hour.
That's what the line sounds like tonight. Clear. Testing done.

kaye_21aug.text:
Hello, this is Mrs. Kaye in 2C. This is a message for Ari. Jad said to ring this number and somebody would pick up, so I'm ringing it. It's about my eye. It's nothing urgent.
You'll ring when you're on your way, won't you, love.
[pause]
Oh, you're not on your way. I'll try again.

teodor_23aug.text:
It is Teodor. 5A. I am not sleeping, so. I say goodnight anyway.
[pause]
It is no trouble for you, I know. It is what you are there for, they said.

teodor_30aug.text:
Teodor. The pool is cold tonight. I did twenty lengths. You would laugh at me.
He would. Goodnight.

nell_2sep.text:
Hi. Um. Hi, Fake Ari. It's Nell.
Tobi's got a temperature, thirty-nine point one, I've done the medicine, I'm not ringing for anything. I just didn't want to wake anyone real.
[laughs]
Okay. Sorry. Bye.

council_11sep.text: This is a message for Ari from Community Services regarding your nomination as a Designated Personal Contact. You have been nominated by more than one resident. You will be contacted about next steps. Please do not reply to this message.

jad_15sep.text:
It's Jad. Obviously.
[pause]
If you were real I'd ask you to water my plants while I'm in Harwick. I haven't got plants. Dima's got plants. Dima's leaving. Everyone's...
Anyway. I'm not going to Harwick. I've put it off again. Don't tell anyone.
You can't tell anyone. That's the whole point of you.

kaye_18sep.text:
It's Mrs. Kaye again. They tell me you start properly on the twenty-sixth. Thursday the first, twenty to nine, the 36 bus. I'll have my good coat on.
You'll ring when you're on your way.

teodor_20sep.text:
Teodor. I left something for you with the bag, at the desk. It was my son's. He won't want it.
You'll need the length in the sleeves.

nell_22sep.text:
A letter came for you. For Ari, Office G/1. I sort the post, so. I've put it in the bag at the desk. It says induction.
I don't...
Okay. Bye.

sal_24sep.text: Good afternoon. Sal Brannock, Community Services, calling for Ari regarding your induction at oh-five-thirty on Saturday the twenty-sixth. Please bring your appointment slip and one witness. If you have any questions, call the desk after eight p.m. Thank you.
